body:
Follow-up to GH-62992, which is in 3.1.0rc0 and not yet in a final release, so this has no whatsnew entry and should go into 3.1.0.

`df.plot(kind="bar", subplots=True)` on a regular-frequency `DatetimeIndex`/`PeriodIndex` drew minor date tick labels on every subplot, not just the bottom one. `BarPlot` installed its dynamic date locators in `_post_plot_logic`, after `_adorn_subplots` had already hidden the shared-x labels. This moves `format_dateaxis` into `_setup_date_axis`, which runs from `_make_plot`, the same place `LinePlot` calls it. The later re-application of `rot`/`fontsize` stays, since `set_xlim` can still create minor ticks after `_post_plot_logic_common` runs (e.g. with a narrow user `xlim`); `test_bar_plot_date_axis_rot_applies_to_minor_ticks` now covers that case.

```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

idx = pd.date_range("2020-01-01", periods=10, freq="D")
axes = pd.DataFrame({"a": np.arange(10), "b": np.arange(10)}, index=idx).plot(kind="bar", subplots=True)
# main: axes[0] shows minor labels '02'..'09'; now hidden, as with kind="line"
```

AI disclosure: drafted with Claude Code (`claude opus 5.5 (high)`), used to diagnose the ordering bug, write the fix and test, and run differential checks against main and `kind="line"`.
title: BUG: bar subplots draw date labels on inner shared-x axes (follow-up to GH#62992)
